entities.summary: Leo Giuseppe Insam was an Italian professional ice hockey defenceman. He played the majority of his pro career in the Italian league with brief stops in Austria and Germany. Insam was a member of the Italian national team in the 1994 and 1998 Winter Olympics. Additionally he played for the junior national team three times and the senior team six times in world championships.
